snippet.title: Escaping Ordinary (B.C Marx)
snippet.description:
Visual Summaries of the Best Books and Ideas :)

I like to bring great books and ideas to life in a visual way.  I love reading and listening to books, so I want to share with others books and Authors I recommend.

My mission for this channel is to get people (especially younger folk)  enthusiastic about picking up books more often and  mindlessly scrolling through TikTok, IG etc. less often. 

FAQ
What do you use to make the videos?

I use everything Adobe, but the main programs I use are
-Illustrator
-After Effects
-Audition
-Premier Pro
-Photoshop (but not often) 

Why are you so slow with your content?

Everything you see in the video was put together by myself, and they take a longggg time, from reading the book, doing voiceovers, making illustrations, editing etc. I currently have a FT job, but I hope in the future I can go PT and create content more often :)

snippet.title: Animated Book Summaries
snippet.description: My goal is to help you make more money, get more done, and have more fun in your day-to-day life. If you want to be healthy, wealthy, wise, and happy, you’ll find my research quite useful. In making these animated book summaries I review and examine the best books in the world on entrepreneurship, time management, personal development, money, health, habits, leadership, sale, philosophy, spirituality & relationships. All condensed into short animated book reviews for easy and fun even entertaining learning.

snippet.title: Chapters & Chaos
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chapters & Chaos! The animated corner of YouTube where your favorite books get lovingly roasted, emotionally dissected, and dramatically reimagined… in cartoon form.

From magical rebellions to enemies-to-lovers mayhem, we bring YA fantasy, dark romance, and chaotic fiction to life with sarcastic voiceovers, spoiler-packed summaries, and absolutely no chill.

Don’t feel like reading 600 pages? We’ve got you. Want to relive your favorite plot twists with extra sass? That too. Subscribe for animated chaos, one tragic chapter at a time.

📚 New episodes every week-ish.
🔥 Spoilers ahead. Daggered feelings guaranteed.
🎥 100% dramatized for your entertainment.

I started my creative career with podcasting, and I wanted to bring good audio to comprehensive animated book summaries.

I hope you enjoy your time on my channel, and I appreciate you stopping by.

Much Love
